blocks.title: Identify the storage mechanism
blocks.text: HDDs use magnetised regions on rotating platters; DVD-style media are read optically.

blocks.title: Explain solid-state storage
blocks.text: Flash cells are non-volatile electronic storage without rotating platters or mechanical head seeks.

blocks.title: Evaluate rather than rank universally
blocks.text: SSD generally has low seek latency and resists mechanical shock; HDD may offer lower cost per GB at large capacities.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict
blocks.text: An SSD is attractive for frequent portable access and avoiding moving parts.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: An HDD can offer capacity at a lower cost; backups remain necessary regardless.
